has_syntax_or_type_error.instructions: In this diff or patch hunk, does an added or changed line introduce a syntax, parse, or type error; missing import; or invalid reference?

criteria.true: A syntax, parse, or type error is introduced in the diff
criteria.false: No syntax or type error worth flagging in the diff

has_exposed_secret.instructions: In this diff or patch hunk, does an added or changed line expose a hardcoded secret, API key, token, password, or credential?

criteria.true: A hardcoded secret or exposed credential is added in the diff
criteria.false: No exposed secret worth flagging in the diff

has_injection_or_xss.instructions: In this diff or patch hunk, does an added or changed line introduce injection risk (SQL, shell, template, command) or XSS / unsafe output?

criteria.true: An injection or XSS risk is introduced in the diff
criteria.false: No injection or XSS risk worth flagging in the diff

has_insecure_auth.instructions: In this diff or patch hunk, does an added or changed line weaken authentication or authorization?

criteria.true: An auth or authorization flaw is introduced in the diff
criteria.false: No auth flaw worth flagging in the diff

has_schema_mismatch.instructions: In this diff or patch hunk, does an added or changed line break an API or schema contract?

criteria.true: A schema or API contract break is introduced in the diff
criteria.false: No schema mismatch worth flagging in the diff

has_logic_bug.instructions: In this diff or patch hunk, does an added or changed line introduce a logic bug (wrong condition, off-by-one, race, null mishandling)?

criteria.true: A plausible logic defect is introduced in the diff
criteria.false: No logic defect worth flagging in the diff
